### 3.2 Working Capital Cycle (In Days)
- **Raw Material / Merchandise Holding Days:** 25 Days (Buffer stock of seeds and fertilizers held prior to sowing).
- **Processing / Bagging Days:** 0 Days (Pure trade domain; zero manufacturing latency).
- **Finished Goods Stock Days:** 15 Days (Retail turnover duration during active season).
- **Customer Credit (*Udhaar / Bahi-Khata*) Days:** 20 Days (Credit extended to trusted local farmers settled post-harvest).
- **Total Working Capital Cycle Length:** `25 + 0 + 15 + 20 = 60 Days` [S8].
- **Operating Working Capital Formula:**
  $$\text{Working Capital Requirement} = \left(\frac{\text{Cycle Days}}{30}\right) \times \text{Monthly Operational Cost} + \text{Rotating Stock Inventory}$$
  $$\text{Working Capital} = \left(\frac{60}{30}\right) \times ₹42,000 + ₹6,16,000 = ₹84,000 + ₹6,16,000 = ₹7,00,000 \text{ [S8]}$$

## 4. UNIT ECONOMICS & PRICING

### 4.1 Product Margins & Pricing Architecture (Regulated vs. Non-Regulated)
- **Urea (45 kg bag):** Maximum Retail Price (MRP) statutorily fixed by Government of India at ₹242 per 45 kg bag (exclusive of neem coating charges/taxes) [S10]. Dealer margin fixed at **₹354 per Metric Tonne** (~₹16.00 per bag, approx. 6.6% gross margin) [S10].
- **Phosphatic & Potassic (P&K) Fertilizers (DAP / NPK):** Decontrolled under Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS). Average retail price: ₹1,350 per 50 kg bag of DAP [S10]. Dealer margin: **₹45 to ₹65 per bag** (3.3% to 4.8%) [S10].
- **Certified & Hybrid Seeds:** Retail price ₹120 to ₹450 per kg depending on crop (Paddy, Wheat, Mustard, Hybrid Maize). Dealer gross margin: **14% to 22%** [S8].
- **Agrochemicals & Bio-stimulants:** Liquid formulations (Insecticides, Herbicides, Micronutrient tonics). Dealer gross margin: **18% to 28%** [S8].

### 4.2 Monthly Revenue & Profitability Model (Normalized Active Month)

### 3.2 Working Capital Cycle (In Days)
- **Raw Material Inventory Days:** 15 Days (Buffer stock of raw wheat and whole pulses).
- **Processing & Conditioning Days:** 2 Days (Water soaking/drying of pulses, stone grinding).
- **Finished Flour & Dal Stock Days:** 5 Days (Buffer stock awaiting retail sale).
- **Customer Credit (*Udhaar*) / Job-Work Lag:** 8 Days (Custom toll milling is mostly instant cash; short credit to local kirana buyers).
- **Total Working Capital Cycle Length:** `15 + 2 + 5 + 8 = 30 Days` [S8].
- **Operating Working Capital Formula:**
  $$\text{Working Capital Requirement} = \left(\frac{\text{Cycle Days}}{30}\right) \times \text{Monthly Operational Cost} + \text{Rotating Raw Grain Inventory}$$
  $$\text{Working Capital} = \left(\frac{30}{30}\right) \times ₹43,450 + ₹2,56,550 = ₹43,450 + ₹2,56,550 = ₹3,00,000 \text{ [S8]}$$

---

## 4. UNIT ECONOMICS & PRICING

### 4.1 Throughput & Processing Economics
- **Daily Operating Hours:** 8 hours/day, 25 working days per month (200 operating hours/month).
- **Monthly Grain Processing Capacity:** 18,000 kg (18 MT) split between:
  - Custom Toll Milling (Job Work): 12,000 kg (66.7%)
  - Own Merchant Milling (Branded Sale): 6,000 kg (33.3%)
- **Toll Milling Service Fees:**
  - Wheat grinding: ₹4.00 per kg [S8].
  - Pulse dehusking / splitting: ₹6.50 per kg [S8].
- **Merchant Milling Price Architecture (Official Benchmark):**
  - Raw Wheat Procurement: Mandi MSP ₹2,425 per quintal (₹24.25/kg) [S10].
  - Chakki Fresh Whole Wheat Atta Retail Price: ₹34.00 to ₹38.00 per kg [S8].
  - By-product Yield: Wheat Bran (*Choker*) 10% (sold to local dairy farmers at ₹20.00/kg) [S8].
  - Raw Gram (Chana) Procurement: Mandi MSP ₹5,650 per quintal (₹56.50/kg) [S10].
  - Polished Chana Dal Retail Price: ₹88.00 to ₹95.00 per kg [S8].
  - Pulse By-product: Chana Chuni / Broken Dal (*Khanda*) 25% (sold as cattle feed at ₹28.00/kg) [S8].

### 4.2 Monthly Revenue & Profitability Model (Normalized Operating Month)
- **Revenue Stream 1: Custom Toll Milling (Job Work):**
  - Wheat toll milling: 9,000 kg @ ₹4.00/kg = ₹36,000
  - Pulse toll milling: 3,000 kg @ ₹6.50/kg = ₹19,500
  - Subtotal Job Work Cash Revenue: **₹55,500** [S8].
- **Revenue Stream 2: Merchant Atta & Dal Sales (Gross Margin):**
  - Branded Atta: 4,000 kg @ ₹36.00/kg = ₹1,44,000 (Raw cost: 4,000 kg @ ₹24.25 = ₹97,000; bran credit: 400 kg @ ₹20 = +₹8,000; Gross Margin = ₹55,000)
  - Branded Chana Dal: 2,000 kg @ ₹90.00/kg = ₹1,80,000 (Raw cost: 2,000 kg @ ₹56.50 = ₹1,13,000; chuni credit: 500 kg @ ₹28 = +₹14,000; Gross Margin = ₹81,000)
  - Total Merchant Gross Margin: **₹1,36,000** [S8].
- **Blended Monthly Gross Income:** `₹55,500 (Job work) + ₹1,36,000 (Merchant margin) = ₹1,91,500` [S8].
- **Direct Variable Power & Processing Cost (excluding fixed overheads):** ~₹28,500.
- **Net Operating Surplus:** 
  $$\text{Net Monthly Surplus} = \text{Gross Income} - \text{Total Operating Costs (₹43,450)} - \text{Direct Milling Inputs (₹28,500)} = ₹1,19,550 \text{ [S8]}$$
  *(In conservative job-work only mode, net monthly surplus is ₹22,000 to ₹35,000).*

### 4.3 Break-Even Capacity Utilization
- **Monthly Fixed Overheads:** ₹33,500 (Rent, wages, electricity base, loan interest).
- **Average Service Margin per kg (Job Work Base):** ₹4.50 per kg.
- **Break-Even Processing Volume:** 
  $$\text{Break-Even Milling Volume} = \frac{₹33,500}{₹4.50} = 7,444 \text{ kg per month (approx. 7.4 MT) [S8]}$$
- **Break-Even Capacity Utilization:** Approximately **41.3%** of single-shift milling capacity.

---

## 5. SEASONALITY MULTIPLIER ARRAY

Milling activity is heavily driven by seasonal crop harvesting and monsoon atmospheric humidity.

  $$\text{Working Capital} = \left(\frac{40}{30}\right) \times ₹49,250 + ₹2,64,333 = ₹65,667 + ₹2,64,333 = ₹3,30,000 \text{ [S8]}$$

## 4. UNIT ECONOMICS & PRICING

### 4.1 Input-Output Mass Balance & Spread Analysis
- **Core Processing Material:** Rapeseed & Mustard Seed (*Brassica juncea*).
- **Official Mandi Procurement Price (MSP RMS 2025-26):** ₹5,950 per quintal (₹59.50/kg) [S10].
- **Physical Extraction Yields per 100 kg Raw Mustard Seed:**
  - Pure Filtered Mustard Oil: **34.0 kg** (approx. 37.3 Litres @ 0.91 kg/L specific gravity) [S8].
  - Mustard Oil Cake (*Sarson Khal*): **64.0 kg** (high protein bovine feed) [S8].
  - Evaporative Moisture / Cleaning Wastage: **2.0 kg** [S8].
- **Output Realization per 100 kg Seed:**
  - Mustard Oil Sales: 34 kg @ ₹155.00/kg (equivalent to ₹141.00/Litre bulk) = **₹5,270.00** [S8].
  - Mustard Cake Sales: 64 kg @ ₹28.50/kg (local dairy farmer pickup) = **₹1,824.00** [S8].
  - **Total Realization per Quintal:** `₹5,270.00 + ₹1,824.00 = ₹7,094.00` [S8].
  - **Gross Value Addition Spread:** `₹7,094.00 - ₹5,950.00 = ₹1,144.00 per quintal` (**19.23% Gross Spread**) [S8].

### 4.2 Monthly Revenue & Profitability Model (Normalized Operating Month)
- **Monthly Processing Volume:** 10,000 kg (10 MT / 100 quintals) of mustard seed [S8].
- **Total Raw Material Cost:** 100 quintals @ ₹5,950 = ₹5,95,000.
- **Total Gross Output Realization:** 100 quintals @ ₹7,094 = ₹7,09,400.
- **Total Gross Operating Spread:** `₹7,09,400 - ₹5,95,000 = ₹1,14,400` [S8].
- **Additional Custom Toll Crushing (2 MT @ ₹7/kg):** `2,000 kg @ ₹7 = ₹14,000`.
- **Total Blended Gross Margin:** `₹1,14,400 + ₹14,000 = ₹1,28,400` [S8].
- **Net Operating Surplus:** 
  $$\text{Net Monthly Surplus} = \text{Gross Margin (₹1,28,400)} - \text{Operating Overheads (₹49,250)} = ₹79,150 \text{ [S8]}$$
  *(In post-harvest peak season, processing 20 MT doubles net surplus to ₹1,45,000/month).*

### 4.3 Break-Even Capacity Utilization
- **Monthly Fixed Overheads:** ₹38,000 (Rent, wages, electricity base, loan interest).
- **Gross Spread per Quintal:** ₹1,144.00 (₹11.44 per kg seed).
- **Break-Even Monthly Seed Crushing Volume:** 
  $$\text{Break-Even Volume} = \frac{₹38,000}{₹11.44} = 3,322 \text{ kg per month (approx. 3.32 MT) [S8]}$$
- **Break-Even Capacity Utilization:** Approximately **22.1%** of single-shift expelling capacity.

### 3.2 Working Capital Cycle (In Days)
- **Raw Whole Spice Holding Days:** 20 Days (Buffer stock of whole dried turmeric fingers, dry chillies, and coriander).
- **Drying & Pulverizing Days:** 3 Days (Sun/tray drying to <10% moisture, coarse crushing, pin-milling, sifting).

- **Operating Working Capital Formula:**
  $$\text{Working Capital Requirement} = \left(\frac{\text{Cycle Days}}{30}\right) \times \text{Monthly Operational Cost} + \text{Rotating Raw Spice Stock}$$
  $$\text{Working Capital} = \left(\frac{48}{30}\right) \times ₹45,125 + ₹2,12,800 = ₹72,200 + ₹2,12,800 = ₹2,85,000 \text{ [S8]}$$

## 4. UNIT ECONOMICS & PRICING

### 4.1 Input Procurement vs. Finished Output Price Architecture
- **Turmeric (*Curcuma longa*):**
  - Raw Dried Turmeric Fingers Mandi Price: ₹14,500 per quintal (₹145.00/kg) [S10].
  - Grinding & Moisture Loss: 3.5% (effective raw cost = ₹150.25/kg) [S8].
  - Packaging & Sealing Cost: ₹18.00/kg (printed 200g metallized pouches) [S8].
  - Packaged Turmeric Powder Retail Price: ₹240.00 to ₹280.00 per kg [S8].
  - Gross Operating Spread: **₹71.75 to ₹111.75 per kg** (30.0% to 39.9% Gross Margin) [S8].
- **Dry Red Chilli (*Capsicum annuum* - Teja/Guntur):**
  - Raw Dry Stemless Chilli Mandi Price: ₹22,000 per quintal (₹220.00/kg) [S10].
  - Processing & Dust Loss: 5.0% (effective raw cost = ₹231.50/kg) [S8].
  - Packaging & Sealing Cost: ₹18.00/kg [S8].
  - Packaged Chilli Powder Retail Price: ₹340.00 to ₹380.00 per kg [S8].
  - Gross Operating Spread: **₹90.50 to ₹130.50 per kg** (26.6% to 34.3% Gross Margin) [S8].
- **Coriander Seeds (*Coriandrum sativum*):**
  - Raw Coriander Seeds Mandi Price: ₹8,000 per quintal (₹80.00/kg).
  - Packaged Coriander Powder Retail Price: ₹170.00 to ₹190.00 per kg. Gross Margin: **42.0%** [S8].
- **Custom Toll Grinding Fee:** ₹20.00 per kg of farmer-supplied dried spices (net cash margin: ~75% above direct power cost) [S8].

### 4.2 Monthly Revenue & Profitability Model (Normalized Operating Month)
- **Monthly Processing Volume:** 2,500 kg total ground spices [S8].
- **Sales Revenue Breakdown:**
  - Turmeric Powder (40% / 1,000 kg @ ₹250/kg): ₹2,50,000 (Gross Margin: 35.0% = ₹87,500)
  - Red Chilli Powder (35% / 875 kg @ ₹350/kg): ₹3,06,250 (Gross Margin: 30.0% = ₹91,875)
  - Coriander Powder (15% / 375 kg @ ₹180/kg): ₹67,500 (Gross Margin: 42.0% = ₹28,350)
  - Custom Toll Grinding (10% / 250 kg @ ₹20/kg): ₹5,000 (Direct Service Margin = ₹3,750)
- **Total Monthly Sales Turnover:** ₹6,28,750 [S8].
- **Total Monthly Gross Margin:** `₹87,500 + ₹91,875 + ₹28,350 + ₹3,750 = ₹2,11,475` (Blended Gross Margin: **33.63%**) [S8].
- **Direct Variable Power & Labour Costs:** ~₹36,500.
- **Net Operating Surplus:** 
  $$\text{Net Monthly Surplus} = \text{Gross Margin} - \text{Fixed Operating Overheads (₹45,125)} - \text{Direct Variable Costs (₹36,500)} = ₹1,29,850 \text{ [S8]}$$
  *(In conservative 50% capacity operation, net monthly surplus is ₹45,000 to ₹65,000).*

### 4.3 Break-Even Capacity Utilization
- **Monthly Fixed Overheads:** ₹35,000 (Rent, wages, electricity base, loan interest).
- **Blended Gross Margin Percentage:** 33.63%.
- **Break-Even Monthly Sales Turnover:** 
  $$\text{Break-Even Turnover} = \frac{₹35,000}{0.3363} = ₹1,04,074 \text{ per month [S8]}$$
- **Break-Even Capacity Utilization:** Approximately **16.6%** of single-shift processing capacity.

## 4. UNIT ECONOMICS & PRICING

### 4.1 Mass Balance & Processing Economics (Onion & Tomato Models)
- **Model 1: Dehydrated White/Red Onion Flakes (*Allium cepa*):**
  - Fresh Onion Mandi Glut Procurement Price: ₹14.00 per kg (₹1,400 per quintal) [S10].
  - Dehydration Yield Ratio: **10:1** (10 kg fresh onion yields 1 kg dehydrated flakes at 6% moisture).
  - Raw Produce Cost per kg Flakes: `10 kg * ₹14.00 = ₹140.00` [S8].
  - Direct Labor (Peeling/Slicing) & Electricity/LPG: ₹32.00 per kg flakes [S8].
  - Food-Grade Packaging (Poly-lined carton): ₹12.00 per kg flakes [S8].
  - **Total Production Cost per kg:** `₹140.00 + ₹32.00 + ₹12.00 = ₹184.00 per kg` [S8].
  - **Bulk Wholesale Selling Price:** ₹280.00 to ₹320.00 per kg [S8].
  - **Gross Value Spread:** `₹290.00 - ₹184.00 = ₹106.00 per kg` (**36.55% Gross Margin**) [S8].
- **Model 2: Dehydrated Tomato Flakes / Powder (*Solanum lycopersicum*):**
  - Fresh Tomato Harvest Glut Price: ₹8.00 per kg.
  - Dehydration Yield Ratio: **15:1** (15 kg fresh tomatoes yields 1 kg tomato flakes).
  - Production Cost per kg Flakes: `(15 * ₹8.00) + ₹40 processing = ₹160.00`.
  - Bulk Wholesale Selling Price: ₹270.00 to ₹310.00 per kg. Gross Margin: **42.8%** [S8].

### 4.2 Monthly Revenue & Profitability Model (Normalized Operating Month)
- **Monthly Processing Volume:** 12,000 kg (12 MT) of fresh vegetables (operating 20 days/month) [S8].
- **Finished Output Generated:** 1,200 kg of dehydrated flakes/powder [S8].
- **Sales Revenue:** 1,200 kg @ ₹290.00/kg average realization = **₹3,48,000** [S8].
- **Raw Material Produce Cost:** 12,000 kg @ ₹14.00/kg = ₹1,68,000.
- **Gross Operating Spread:** `₹3,48,000 - ₹1,68,000 = ₹1,80,000` (Blended Spread: **51.7%**) [S8].
- **Net Operating Surplus:** 
  $$\text{Net Monthly Surplus} = \text{Gross Spread (₹1,80,000)} - \text{Total Operating Costs (₹49,100)} - \text{Direct Packaging & Freight (₹38,000)} = ₹92,900 \text{ [S8]}$$
  *(During peak summer harvest glut, processing scales to 18 MT, generating net surplus of ₹1,40,000/month).*

### 4.3 Break-Even Capacity Utilization
- **Monthly Fixed Overheads:** ₹38,000 (Rent, wages, electricity base, loan interest).
- **Net Spread per kg Finished Flakes:** ₹106.00 per kg.
- **Break-Even Finished Production:** 
  $$\text{Break-Even Flakes Volume} = \frac{₹38,000}{₹106.00} = 358.5 \text{ kg per month (approx. 3.6 MT fresh produce) [S8]}$$
- **Break-Even Capacity Utilization:** Approximately **29.8%** of single-shift dehydration capacity.

### 3.2 Working Capital Cycle (In Days)
- **Raw Cow Dung & Biomass Pre-Decomposition Days:** 15 Days (Raw dung must undergo 10–15 days thermophilic pre-curing to dissipate heat before introducing earthworms).
- **Active Earthworm Digestion & Casting Cycle:** 45 Days (Eisenia foetida ingestion and biological casting formation).
- **Curing, Screening & Bagging Days:** 10 Days (Drying to 20% moisture, rotary sieving, packing).
- **Customer Credit (*Udhaar*) / Receivables:** 20 Days (Credit extended to local farmers and nursery owners).
- **Total Working Capital Cycle Length:** `15 + 45 + 10 + 20 = 90 Days` [S8].
- **Operating Working Capital Formula:**
  $$\text{Working Capital Requirement} = \left(\frac{\text{Cycle Days}}{30}\right) \times \text{Monthly Operational Cost} + \text{Rotating Raw Dung Stock}$$
  $$\text{Working Capital} = \left(\frac{90}{30}\right) \times ₹41,600 + ₹1,75,200 = ₹1,24,800 + ₹1,75,200 = ₹3,00,000 \text{ [S8]}$$

---

## 4. UNIT ECONOMICS & PRICING

### 4.1 Biological Conversion Mass Balance & Price Architecture
- **Raw Material Input:** 
  - Fresh Cow Dung Procurement Price: ₹750 per trolley (approx. 2 MT = ₹0.375 per kg) [S8].
  - Crop Residue / Dry Leaves: ₹0.25 per kg (or collected free from farm stubble) [S8].
  - Blended Substrate Mixture: 70% Cow Dung + 30% Shredded Biomass.
- **Conversion Efficiency:** 
  - Earthworms consume their body weight in organic matter daily.
  - 2.5 kg of pre-digested organic waste produces **1.0 kg of screened, dry vermicompost** (40% conversion yield) [S8].
  - Direct Raw Material Cost per kg Finished Vermicompost: `2.5 kg * ₹0.35 = ₹0.875 per kg` [S8].
  - Variable Production Cost (Labor, water, packaging): ₹1.60 per kg [S8].
  - **Total Production Cost per kg:** `₹0.875 + ₹1.60 = ₹2.475 per kg (approx. ₹2.50/kg)` [S8].
- **Revenue Realization Architecture:**
  - Bulk Screened Vermicompost (50 kg bags): ₹6.50 to ₹7.50 per kg (₹325 to ₹375 per bag) [S8].
  - Premium Retail Nursery Packs (5 kg zip pouch): ₹14.00 to ₹18.00 per kg [S8].
  - Liquid Vermiwash: ₹35.00 per Litre (drainage yield: ~25 Litres per bed monthly = 750 Litres/month across 30 beds) [S8].
  - Earthworm Biomass Multiplier: Earthworm population doubles every 60–75 days; 30 beds produce 50 kg of excess worms monthly, sold at ₹350/kg = ₹17,500 [S8].

### 4.2 Monthly Revenue & Profitability Model (Normalized Operating Month)
- **Monthly Finished Production (30 Beds):** 15,000 kg (15 MT / 300 bags) of screened vermicompost [S8].
- **Monthly Sales Revenue:**
  - Bulk Vermicompost Sales: 15,000 kg @ ₹6.50/kg = **₹97,500**
  - Liquid Vermiwash Sales: 750 Litres @ ₹35.00/Litre = **₹26,250**
  - Earthworm Biomass Sales: 50 kg @ ₹350.00/kg = **₹17,500**
- **Total Monthly Gross Realization:** `₹97,500 + ₹26,250 + ₹17,500 = ₹1,41,250` [S8].
- **Raw Material Dung & Biomass Cost:** 37.5 MT dung @ ₹375/MT = ₹14,060.
- **Total Monthly Gross Spread:** `₹1,41,250 - ₹14,060 = ₹1,27,190` (Blended Spread: **90.0%**) [S8].
- **Net Operating Surplus:** 
  $$\text{Net Monthly Surplus} = \text{Gross Spread (₹1,27,190)} - \text{Operating Overheads (₹41,600)} = ₹85,590 \text{ [S8]}$$
  *(During peak pre-sowing planting windows, net monthly surplus reaches ₹1,10,000).*

### 4.3 Break-Even Capacity Utilization
- **Monthly Fixed Overheads:** ₹33,000 (Rent, base power, staff, loan interest).
- **Net Operating Spread per kg Compost:** ₹4.00 per kg (excluding worm/vermiwash bonus).
- **Break-Even Monthly Production Volume:** 
  $$\text{Break-Even Volume} = \frac{₹33,000}{₹4.00} = 8,250 \text{ kg per month (approx. 8.25 MT) [S8]}$$
- **Break-Even Capacity Utilization:** Approximately **55.0%** of single-cycle vermicomposting capacity.
